title: listings.draft_content
description: Owner-scoped read of one listing's DRAFT twins, for a service that works on a draft it was not handed in a request body (a composer's analysis job addressed by draft id). Draft twin first, published column only as a fallback - the opposite order to listings.moderation_content, because screening judges what is live while a composer works on what the seller is writing. Answers {listing_id, owner_id, category_id, title, description, images, features, language, is_empty}; `features` is the seller's features_draft slug->value map with no published fallback (the published column is a display projection, a different shape). Raises LookupError both for an unknown listing and for one owned by somebody else, so the call is not an existence oracle over other people's drafts.

listing_id.description: Primary key of the listing whose draft is being read.

owner_id.description: The asking principal. Must equal the listing's owner; a mismatch is a LookupError, worded exactly as an unknown listing.
